sql.query: INSERT INTO tbl_contract_templates (tenantId,templateName,description,bodyHtml,versionNumber,isActive,createdByUserId,modifiedByUserId) SELECT :tenantId,:templateName,NULLIF(:description,''),:bodyHtml,1,:isActive,:userId,:userId2 FROM DUAL WHERE NULLIF(TRIM(:templateName2),'') IS NOT NULL AND NULLIF(TRIM(:bodyHtml2),'') IS NOT NULL AND EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM tbl_tenant_modules tm INNER JOIN tbl_modules m ON m.id=tm.moduleId AND m.moduleCode='CONTRACT_GENERATION' AND m.isActive=1 WHERE tm.tenantId=:moduleTenant AND tm.status IN ('ACTIVE','TRIAL')) AND EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM tbl_user_tenant_roles utr INNER JOIN tbl_roles r ON r.id=utr.roleId AND r.isActive=1 INNER JOIN tbl_role_permissions rp ON rp.roleId=r.id INNER JOIN tbl_permissions p ON p.id=rp.permissionId AND p.permissionCode='agreements.configure' AND p.isActive=1 WHERE utr.userId=:roleUser AND utr.tenantId=:roleTenant AND utr.isActive=1)
SELECT id FROM tbl_contract_templates WHERE tenantId=:tenantId AND templateName=:templateName AND createdByUserId=:userId ORDER BY id DESC LIMIT 1

INSERT INTO tbl_contract_template_clauses (tenantId,templateId,clauseId,clauseNameSnapshot,clauseHtmlSnapshot,sortOrder) SELECT c.tenantId,:templateId,c.id,c.clauseName,c.clauseHtml,FIND_IN_SET(c.id,:clauseIds) FROM tbl_contract_clauses c WHERE c.tenantId=:tenantId AND FIND_IN_SET(c.id,:clauseIds2)>0
